verdict: Caution: lend selectively to Puducherry electrical-equipment and pump/motor MSMEs with export orders and clean receivables; avoid those tied to local demand or thin-margin government pump tenders.
title: Puducherry Electrical Equipment, Pumps & Motors: a note to the credit manager
narrative:
## What this business physically is
**These units wind copper into stators, cast and machine housings, assemble pumps and motors, and sell either to OEMs, to government pump schemes, or export.** Cash comes in on dispatch, but the real money sits in copper and steel inventory and in receivables. **Copper is the swing cost, so when a proposal lands, check how much of the order book is copper-indexed; if the buyer refuses a price-variation clause, ask for the last six months of gross margin by customer.**

## Where value and cash sit now
**National demand is strong: IIP for NIC 27 output is +30.9% YoY and +28.5% Apr-to-date [D].** But Puducherry is not sharing that: GST collections are -20.7% Apr-to-date against India +6.1%, and electricity demand is +6.1% against India +9.5% [D]. **Read that as a local demand and cash-cycle problem, not an industry problem.** Peer evidence says the same: Shakti Pumps grew H1 FY27 revenue 24.5% YoY to ₹16,047 Mn but PAT fell to ₹90.10 crore from ₹187.54 crore, with margins hit by lower realisations and higher raw-material and logistics costs and working-capital outflows [5]. **Pursue second-tier OEM suppliers to railways, wind power and specialty motors** — Pitti Engineering's call flags these as the valuable complex applications [4]. **Avoid pure local-government pump tender suppliers and single-customer units**; that is where the local GST and power-demand weakness bites first [D]. ## How to grow safely
**Structure against the working-capital cycle, not the fixed assets.** Rating reports show this sector's pattern: one company incurred around ₹780 crore of capex over three years and added around ₹600 crore of working capital, part-funded by fresh equity [9]; another carries high working-capital intensity [8]. **So take stock statements and debtor-ageing every month, and a drawing-power calculation against a sanctioned limit that assumes copper prices stay where they are.** Covenant on total outside liabilities to tangible net worth and on debtor days; if debtor days cross the sanctioned threshold, ask for the top-ten buyer list and stop enhancement. ## Early-warning signs
**Watch the local signal, not the national one.** If GST collections in Puducherry stay negative for another quarter [D], treat any local-order-dependent borrower as stressed. **Watch margin, not revenue:** Shakti's Q1 FY27 revenue rose 37.9% YoY to ₹858.67 crore while PAT fell 46.72% to ₹51.59 crore [7]. **If a borrower's revenue grows while PAT falls, ask for the customer-wise realisation sheet before renewing.** Note the local sources are thin on this specific industry in this city — the OneFirmIntel directory lists 305 electricals companies in Puducherry [3] but gives no financials, so lean on first principles and the peers above.
